answer: Each agent locks a 2000-credit bond refundable after 40 clean epochs and proves unique pigment via an umber-timed puzzle taking 90 serial seconds of exclusive compute per identity. At the network zenith a farm of N sybils freezes 2000N capital for weeks and rents N dedicated cores at once; matching answers in the same window forfeit both bonds. Honest agents pay the wait once and get full refund, so scaling fakes multiplies capital and compute linearly while rewards stay fixed, making large-scale forgery unviable.
